official.deadline_note: No application deadline is published. The school states that scholarships are awarded on a rolling basis, which means the budget available for scholarships may be used before the end of the Master's admission cycle, and strongly recommends applying as early as possible. Applications are open for the Fall Intake, but interest in a merit scholarship can only be considered at the time of the application to the Master's programme - not afterwards.
official.application_cycle: Rolling, aligned with the Master's admission cycle; the page currently shows applications open for the Fall Intake, and the DGES Scholarship for 2026/27 opening on 14 August
official.status_note: The Nova SBE page states 'Applications are open for the Fall Intake' while also publishing the general note on 14 August 2025 that merit scholarship applications continue to be taken on a rolling basis, with the DGES Scholarship for 2026/27 opening on 14 August.
official.tuition_coverage_note: All Nova SBE scholarships on this page are expressed as a percentage of the tuition fee value of the Master's programme. The page states explicitly that the scholarship prize does not fund the application fee, the first installment of tuition paid as the enrollment fee, the CEMS programme, the Double Degree programme, amounts associated with additional semesters, exchange programmes, or Executive Master's programmes.
benefits: Nova SBE Merit Scholarship: covers 20% or 50% of the tuition fee value of the Master's programme
Nova SBE Social Mobility Scholarship: covers 20%, 50% or 100% of the tuition fee value
Nova SBE Continuity Scholarship: covers 50% or 100% of the tuition fee value
Nova SBE Women in Finance Scholarship: covers 20% or 50% of the tuition fee value
Accenture Scholarship, Andre Sousa Bessa Scholarship, Antonio Serrenho Scholarship and Banco Primus Scholarship: cover 100% of the tuition fee value
When a student is granted different scholarships within Nova SBE, the funding cannot exceed 70% of the total tuition fee, except where funding comes entirely from a 100% social mobility scholarship
eligibility: Merit Scholarship: all candidates can apply regardless of their country of origin
Social Mobility Scholarship: all candidates can apply regardless of their country of origin, with proven need for financial aid
Continuity Scholarship: students who obtained a Bachelor's degree at Nova SBE, or who are in the process of concluding it, and who were admitted to any Master's programme at Nova SBE
Continuity Scholarship income test: per capita gross income of less than 40 times the value of the IAS
Women in Finance Scholarship: candidates admitted to the International Master's in Finance who indicate interest in the Nova SBE Merit Scholarship

Accenture Scholarship: enrolment in Business Analytics, Management, Finance, International Master's in Management or International Master's in Finance, plus eligibility for a Nova SBE Social Mobility or Continuity Scholarship of 100%; priority to applicants with a disability rating of 60% or higher

Andre Sousa Bessa Scholarship: Portuguese students enrolled in the Master's in Finance or the International Master's in Finance with high academic performance and financial constraints, engaged in the community, and eligible for a Nova SBE Social Mobility Scholarship of 100%
requirements: Candidates must show interest in a merit scholarship during their application to the Master's programme, by filling in the designated field in the Master's application form
Interest cannot be considered after the application to the Master's programme has been submitted
To maintain an awarded merit scholarship, students need to check the merit criteria at the end of their first year of the Master's programme
Candidates are responsible for checking their email regularly during the application cycle
documents: For Social Mobility-type scholarships, the Master's application form field for this matter, plus the household tax documentation required
Candidates whose household obtained and declared income in Portuguese territory: IRS Model 3 concerning the previous fiscal year available at the time of the application
Documents must be originals or copies, accompanied by a certified translation into English or Portuguese if written in any other language
For the Andre Sousa Bessa Scholarship: the most recent household tax return properly identified
selection_criteria: Scholarships are awarded on a rolling basis to applicants, and the available budget may be used before the end of the Master's admission cycle

Women in Finance Scholarship: ranked on the final score resulting from the weighting of the application score and the positioning of the applicant's Bachelor's programme institution in international rankings
coverage: A percentage of the tuition fee value of the Master's programme, from 20% to 100% depending on the award
Combined Nova SBE awards are capped at 70% of the total tuition fee

The scholarship does not fund the application fee, the first installment of tuition paid as the enrollment fee, the CEMS programme, the Double Degree programme, additional semesters, exchange programmes or Executive Master's programmes
application_method: Fill in the designated field in the Master's application form to express interest in the merit scholarship
Add the required household tax documentation where the scholarship is means-tested
Monitor email for the school's decision, since awards are made on a rolling basis
official.application_route: Indicate interest in the designated field of the Nova SBE Master's application form at the time of application; scholarships cannot be considered once the Master's application has been submitted.
official.citizenship_residency: All candidates can apply for the Merit and Social Mobility Scholarships regardless of their country of origin; the Andre Sousa Bessa Scholarship is restricted to Portuguese students
official.international_eligibility: Yes - the Merit and Social Mobility Scholarships are open to all candidates regardless of country of origin
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Several awards are tied to specific programmes: the Women in Finance Scholarship to the International Master's in Finance, the Accenture Scholarship to Business Analytics, Management, Finance, International Master's in Management or International Master's in Finance, and the Andre Sousa Bessa Scholarship to the Master's in Finance or the International Master's in Finance
official.description: Nova School of Business and Economics believes in distinguishing its students' academic merit and offers merit, social mobility, continuity, sponsor and government-funded scholarships covering a percentage of the tuition fee value of a Master's programme, awarded on a rolling basis during the Master's admission cycle.
official.program_type: University merit, need-based and sponsor-funded tuition-fee scholarships for Master's programmes
official.english_requirement: Documents not written in Portuguese or English are not considered unless accompanied by a certified translation into English or Portuguese.

verification.notes: Read the Nova SBE Scholarships and Funding for Master's Programs page, including the Merit, Social Mobility, Continuity, Women in Finance, Accenture, Andre Sousa Bessa, Antonio Serrenho and DGES scholarship entries. The 70% combined cap and the list of costs the scholarship does not fund are quoted from the page.

applicant_utility.summary: The single most important mechanic here is that scholarship interest is expressed inside the Master's application form, not after it - submit the application without ticking the designated field and you are out, with no later route. Because awards are rolling, the school warns the budget can run out before the admission cycle ends, so apply in the autumn window rather than waiting for a deadline that never arrives. Read the fine print on what the prize does not pay: application fee, the first installment paid as the enrollment fee, CEMS, Double Degree, extra semesters, exchanges and Executive Masters are all excluded, and combined Nova SBE awards are capped at 70% of tuition unless the funding is entirely a 100% social mobility scholarship.
applicant_utility.best_fit: High-performing applicants to Nova SBE Master's programmes who can apply early and express interest at the point of application, plus means-tested applicants with Portuguese household income documentation and Nova SBE bachelor's graduates eligible for the Continuity Scholarship.
application_readiness_checklist: Fill in the designated scholarship interest field in the Master's application form - this is the only point at which interest is considered
Apply as early as possible, because scholarship money is allocated on a rolling basis and can be exhausted before the cycle closes
Establish whether the IAS-relative income test matters for you: the Continuity Scholarship requires per capita gross income below 40 times the IAS
Prepare IRS Model 3 for the previous fiscal year if your household declared income in Portuguese territory, with a certified English or Portuguese translation if it is in another language

Check whether the programme you want is in the eligible list for sponsor awards (Business Analytics, Management, Finance, International Master's in Management, International Master's in Finance for the Accenture Scholarship)
Plan for the first installment paid as the enrollment fee, which is never funded
common_rejection_risks: Submitting the Master's application without expressing interest in the scholarship field, which is irreversible
Applying late in the cycle after the scholarship budget has been spent
Assuming the award covers the enrollment-fee first installment, application fee, CEMS, Double Degree, extra semesters or exchanges
Assuming combined awards can exceed 70% of tuition - the cap binds unless you hold a full 100% social mobility scholarship
Losing a merit scholarship in year two by failing to check the merit criteria at the end of the first year
Sending documents in a language other than Portuguese or English without a certified translation
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Living costs are not covered at all - every Nova SBE award is a tuition-fee percentage only. You also carry the application fee, the enrollment-fee first installment, and any CEMS, Double Degree, extra-semester or exchange costs, so budget for full living expenses in Cascais/Lisbon.
document_audit: The Master's application form's designated scholarship-interest field is the application document - there is no separate portal
Means-tested awards require household tax documentation; for income declared in Portuguese territory that is IRS Model 3 for the previous fiscal year
For the Andre Sousa Bessa Scholarship, the most recent household tax return must be properly identified
All foreign-language documents need a certified translation into English or Portuguese, and certified translations take time to arrange
Accepted students for some sponsor awards must pay the enrollment-fee first installment before being considered, so do not assume the award removes every upfront payment
alerts: Scholarships are rolling and the budget can be exhausted before the admission cycle ends - treat early action as the deadline
Interest cannot be registered after the Master's application is submitted, so read this page before you apply
The DGES state scholarship is a separate route with its own timetable - for 2026/27 it opened on 14 August
The Continuity Scholarship's income test is expressed relative to the IAS, so check the current IAS value rather than a remembered threshold
Sponsor awards such as Accenture give priority to applicants with a disability rating of 60% or higher
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Apply to the Master's programme, tick the scholarship-interest field in the same form, upload means-tested documentation if applicable, then monitor email for a rolling decision while assuming you carry living costs and the enrollment-fee installment yourself.
